## 3. The soft-source machinery is preserved and strengthened

The direct-current route does not invalidate the acquired core and soft-source construction. Those remain useful, and their connection to all-minus can be sharpened.

Let \(A=C_r\), including any overlap \(A\cap B\). Retain
\[
C=C_\kappa,\qquad
N=N_\kappa,\qquad Q=N/C.
\]
Start from \(\mu_A\), and stop at
\[
S=\tau_B\wedge\zeta_A,
\]
where \(\zeta_A\) is the rate-\(\kappa\) clock run in core local time. Write
\[
p=\mathbb P_{\mu_A}(\tau_B<\zeta_A),
\qquad
m=\mathbb E_{\mu_A}S.
\]

The exact identities are
\[
\boxed{
p=\frac{C}{\kappa Z_A},
\qquad
m=\frac{N}{\kappa Z_A},
\qquad
Q=\frac mp.
}
\tag{6}
\]
Here \(m\) includes all failed excursions, returns, holding times, and growth to the actual target.

The clock compensator gives
\[
1-p
=
\kappa\mathbb E_{\mu_A}\int_0^S\mathbf1_A(X_t)\,dt
\le\kappa m,
\]
hence
\[
\frac1p\le1+\kappa Q.
\]
Combining this with the supplied source join proves
\[
\boxed{
Q\le T_h\le(1+\kappa D_0)Q+D_0.
}
\tag{7}
\]
This holds for every \(\kappa>0\); the condition \(\kappa D_0<1\) is unnecessary for this sharper inequality.

### An acquired normalizer controls a larger actual droplet basin

Define \(\mathcal M_5\) by requiring every augmented plus component to have a nonwinding lift with an embedded filled outer disk of area at most \(5R^2\). Filled disks include holes, nested contours, and their spins. Assume
\[
5R^2<L^2/4,
\]
which is compatible with sufficiently large fixed \(C\).

Then \(\mathcal M_5\) is a down-set and \(A\subseteq\mathcal M_5\). Set
\[
b_\theta=\theta\left(2-\frac{\sqrt5}{2}\right),
\qquad q_\theta=4e^{-b_\theta},
\qquad
u_r=\frac{6nq_\theta^{2r}}{1-q_\theta}.
\]
For \(\theta\ge4\), \(q_\theta<0.118\), and
\[
\boxed{
\mu_{\mathcal M_5}(A^c)\le u_r.
}
\]
When \(u_r<1\),
\[
\boxed{
1\le\frac{Z_{\mathcal M_5}}{Z_A}\le\frac1{1-u_r},
\qquad
\frac{Z_{\mathcal M_5\setminus A}}{Z_A}
\le s_r:=\frac{u_r}{1-u_r}.
}
\tag{8}
\]

The proof preserves thermal entropy. For a specified outer contour, flip every spin in its filled disk. This injective operation retains the complementary interior configuration. With physical perimeter \(P\) and filled area \(V\),
\[
\frac{w(x)}{w(F_\gamma x)}
\le e^{-2\theta P+2\theta V/R}.
\]
The inequalities \(P\ge4\sqrt V\) and \(V\le5R^2\) give the exponent \(-b_\theta P\). The diagonal-resolved contour count is at most \(6n4^P\);

source_excerpts.text:
## 5. Existing splitting methods receive an exact full-duration formulation

The statistical wrapper does not need to be new.

For nested stopping fronts
\[
H_0=\Omega\supseteq H_1\supseteq\cdots\supseteq H_K=B,
\]
retain the complete microscopic first-arrival law at each front. Let \(q_j\) be the probability of reaching the next front before the core clock, and let \(d_j\) be the expected complete duration of that segment, including backward excursions and returns.

Then
\[
p_j=\prod_{i<j}q_i,
\qquad
m=\sum_{j<K}p_jd_j,
\]
and
\[
\boxed{
Q=\frac{\sum_{j<K}p_jd_j}{p_K}.
}
\tag{16}
\]

This is the full residence operation for a conventional splitting architecture. Keeping only \(p_K\) omits the duration reward.

Constant next-front probabilities and short individual segments do not establish efficient acquisition of the arrival laws. A simple two-label example makes this precise: an initial label of probability \(a^K\) can carry approximately half of the final success probability, while every next-level crossing probability stays between \(a\) and \(1\). Polynomially many initial particles miss that label with probability tending to one. This is a generic diagnostic, not an Ising impossibility result.

FFPilot already learns crossing probabilities, initial waiting-time variability, and per-interface costs, and discusses errors caused by memory between phases. The missing theorem is a uniform Ising coverage and cost guarantee, not the idea of learning interfaces or allocating effort from pilot measurements. :chatgpt-content-reference{index="3"}

Likewise, nonasymptotic Feynman–Kac relative-error bounds depend on explicit mixing and continuation regularity. Establishing polynomial versions of those conditions for the acquired Ising representation would make an existing method effective. :chatgpt-content-reference{index="4"}
